methodologyNotes: Fourteen current-production camping lanterns verified 2026-08-11 primarily against manufacturer product pages (Goal Zero, BioLite, Black Diamond, Streamlight, Fenix, Ledlenser, LuminAID) fetched directly, corroborated by major retailer listings (REI, Coleman, Campmor, Liberty Mountain, Amazon, Walmart) where a manufacturer figure was unavailable; a small number of fields (Coleman Quad Pro 800L direct pricing, exact MPOWERD Luci Pro Outdoor 2.0 battery mAh, Ledlenser ML6 US-dollar price, Nite Ize Radiant 314 MSRP) could not be pulled from a manufacturer page that blocked automated fetches, so the best-corroborated retailer figure is used and flagged in each product's priceNote/provenance rather than guessed from an unrelated source.

products.name: Goal Zero Lighthouse 600 Lantern & USB Power Hub

specs.runtimeLowHighHr: 320 hr low / 5 hr high (single side lit); 180 hr low / 2.5 hr high (both sides lit)
specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: Yes - USB-A power-bank output; charges via USB, solar panel (Nomad 10), or hand crank
specs.colorTemperatureModes: Single warm-white LED, 3500K, brightness-adjustable only (no CCT/color modes)
specs.collapsibleHangingDesign: Folding hand-crank arm doubles as hanging hook; collapsible fold-out legs

products.provenance: All specs confirmed directly on Goal Zero's own product page: 600 lm warm-white (3500K) LED, 5200mAh/18.98Wh internal Li-ion, 1.1 lb (498g), and the full low/high runtime chart for single- and dual-side illumination. Goal Zero's page does not state an IP rating, so that field records the absence rather than assuming a value. Three charging paths (USB, solar, hand crank) confirmed on the same page.

products.name: Goal Zero Crush Light Solar Lantern

specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: No power-bank output; recharges via USB-A cable or built-in solar panel
specs.colorTemperatureModes: Warm-white LED with flickering candle mode; high/medium/low brightness steps
specs.collapsibleHangingDesign: Fully collapsible/crushable silicone accordion body; integrated hang loop

products.provenance: All specs confirmed directly on Goal Zero's own product page: 60/25/6 lm across high/medium/low, 500mAh (1.85Wh) battery, 3.2 oz (91g) weight, and runtime figures (3 hr high, 6 hr medium, 35 hr low, 3.5 hr candle mode). IPX4 rating corroborated by B&H Photo and Amazon listings.

products.name: BioLite AlpenGlow 500 Rechargeable Camping Lantern

specs.runtimeLowHighHr: 200 hr low / 5 hr high (plus 1 hr reserve power)
specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: Yes - 1x USB-A 5V/2.4A power-bank output; charges via Micro-USB (5V/2A, ~3 hr)
specs.colorTemperatureModes: 1900K-5000K adjustable warm-to-cool white plus full RGB color mixing (ChromaReal LED, CRI 90)
specs.collapsibleHangingDesign: Fixed cylindrical body with fold-out top hanging hook and carry loop

products.provenance: Price ($79.95) confirmed directly on BioLite's own product page. Lumens, battery capacity, runtime, weight, dimensions, IPX4 rating, and CRI-90 ChromaReal LED spec cross-confirmed identically on the Amazon listing and REI product page.

products.name: BioLite AlpenGlow 250 Lantern

specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: Yes - USB-A power-bank output; charges via Micro-USB (~2.5 hr)
specs.colorTemperatureModes: 1900K-5000K adjustable warm-to-cool white plus full RGB color mixing
specs.collapsibleHangingDesign: Fixed cylindrical body with fold-out top hanging hook and carry loop

products.name: Black Diamond Moji R+ Rechargeable Lantern

specs.runtimeLowHighHr: 16 hr low / 2-3 hr high (approx., per manufacturer lowest-setting burn-time spec)
specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: No power-bank output; recharges via integrated Micro-USB port
specs.colorTemperatureModes: Full-spectrum RGB color mixing plus warm-white campfire flicker mode
specs.collapsibleHangingDesign: Compact fixed globe body with 4 embedded magnets for mounting; no fold-out hook

Note: a generic aggregated listing elsewhere cites a much lower ~3 oz figure for this model, but the manufacturer's own stated 170g is used as authoritative.

products.name: Black Diamond Apollo Lantern

specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: Yes - USB port charges phones/small electronics; internal battery fully recharges in 8 hr via USB

specs.collapsibleHangingDesign: Folding wire hanging hook and flip-out stabilizing legs

products.name: Coleman Quad Pro 800L LED Panel Lantern
products.priceNote: Representative current retail; Boatzon lists $104.99. coleman.com blocked automated fetch so its exact live price could not be confirmed directly.

specs.runtimeLowHighHr: 400 hr low / 20 hr high (base with 8x D-cell batteries, all 4 panels combined)
specs.batteryTypeCapacityMah: 4-8x D-cell (base, not included) + 3x AAA NiMH per detachable panel (included)
specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: No - battery-powered only, no USB charging or power-bank output
specs.colorTemperatureModes: Single cool-white LED per panel, no CCT/color modes; high/low per-panel settings
specs.collapsibleHangingDesign: 4 detachable panels each with hook/magnet for independent use, plus central hanging loop on the base

products.provenance: coleman.com is the manufacturer's own current product page for SKU 2000030727 (confirmed present via search indexing) but returned HTTP 403 on direct automated fetch, so lumens (800 combined / 100 per panel), battery configuration (4-8x D-cell base + 3x AAA NiMH per panel), 3.05 lb weight, and runtime chart (20/120/400 hr on 8x D at high/med/low) are taken from the reproduced Coleman spec sheet on Hodges Marine, Anchor Express, and the Amazon listing, all of which match each other exactly.

products.priceNote: Streamlight.com does not display consumer pricing; current Walmart retail used ($43.63), Amazon/BrightGuy commonly $34-40

specs.rechargeableUsbOutput: Yes - USB-A output for mobile device charging; recharges via USB (few hours) or solar panel (~14 hr full sun)

products.provenance: MPOWERD's own mpowerd.com product URLs returned 404/unreachable on direct automated fetch during this pass, so specs are drawn from retailer pages (Campmor, GoSupps, Best Buy, North 40) that reproduce MPOWERD's official spec sheet for the current Luci Pro Outdoor 2.0 model: 150/135 lm (clear/matte), 5.5 oz (156g), IP67, up to 50 hr runtime, and USB + solar charging. Battery mAh is approximate (~2000mAh) as no fetched retailer page stated an exact figure for this specific 2.0 variant, distinct from the higher-capacity Luci Pro Lux sibling model.
